description: This file is a utility module for logging within a larger machine learning or language model framework. It handles pre- and post-call logging, cost calculations, callback processing, and integration with various external logging and monitoring services. The file defines the `Logging` class which manages detailed logging, callback invocation, cost calculation, and debug assistance throughout the model invocation lifecycle.

classes.description: Main class managing logging for model calls, including callback processing, cost calculation, and debugging assistance. Implements pre- and post-call logging, callback invocation, and cost evaluation within the large framework.
